name: PGC 6240 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 6240, an elliptical galaxy ringed by shells of stars, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc6240-hubble
story: Like a pale rose, hazy shells of stars encircle a very bright center, likely the aftermath of a recent merger that also gave rise to new, younger globular clusters.

claims.text: Hazy shells of stars encircle a very bright center
It likely merged with another galaxy recently
The merger created new, younger globular clusters
It was observed in HST program 10227, a study of shell ellipticals
